name: error-summary
purpose: Lists every error after a failed submission as links that move focus to the offending field (GOV.UK error summary pattern). The summary is a labelled region that receives focus when shown, so screen readers announce its heading and contents once without a live region. Form uses it automatically; it can also be used on its own.
whenToUse: After a failed form submission, to list all errors at the top of the form with links to each field.
Showing server-side errors after a full page load, including errors that belong to no field.
whenNotToUse: Inline messages next to a field: controls render those; for other controls use Validation Message.
Non-error notices or confirmations: use an alert or toast.
Forms managed by Form: it creates and fills the summary itself (use Form's summaryHost to place it).
responsive: Block-level grid that fills its container; messages wrap.
rtl: Logical properties: the thick border is on the inline-start side and list indentation is inline-start in both directions.
theme: Error subtle background, error foreground border, heading, and links, with a thicker inline-start border. Links are underlined so color is not the only cue. Forced-colors mode uses CanvasText for the border and LinkText for links.
security: Heading, description, and messages are rendered with textContent; messages are never parsed as HTML. Link hrefs are only #<id> fragments of the targets. CSP-safe.
dataHandling: No persistence, network access, or telemetry.

budgets.budget: No dedicated performance test; renders one list item per error

performance.testedScale: Unit tests cover summaries with up to four items.

limitations: A target without an id receives a generated id (the consumer element is modified).
Link activation is handled in script; without script the #id link only scrolls, and focus lands on the target only if it is focusable.
Heading levels are limited to 2, 3, and 4.
unsupported: Rendering HTML or custom content in items.
Items with actions other than navigation.
antiPatterns: Showing the summary while the user is typing; show it after submission.
Using different wording in the summary and the inline message for the same field.
Adding a live region around the summary: it is announced by moving focus.

adapters.angular: @absoluteui/angular/error-summary: AuiErrorSummary directive ([auiErrorSummary]); call show() on its controller.
